Cyclical patterns in emoji use

Source: R/emoji-time.R
emoji_seasonality.Rd

emoji_seasonality() aggregates emoji use by month of year, day of week or hour of day. Emoji use is strongly seasonal and strongly diurnal, and both are confounders worth seeing before any trend is interpreted.

Usage

emoji_seasonality(data, text, time, period = c("month", "weekday", "hour"))

Arguments

data

A data frame or tibble containing a text column.

text

The text column to scan, supplied unquoted.

time

Unquoted column of dates or date-times (Date, POSIXct, or character in "YYYY-MM-DD" form).

period

"month" (default), "weekday" or "hour". "hour" needs a POSIXct/POSIXlt time column.

Value

A tibble with one row per level of the cycle: .period (integer: 1-12, 1-7 with Monday first, or 0-23), .period_label, n_texts, n_with_emoji, n_emoji, emoji_per_text and share (this level's share of all emoji tokens).

Details

Every level of the cycle is returned, including the empty ones, so a bar chart has no invisible gaps. Labels are fixed English abbreviations rather than locale-dependent ones, so the output of a script does not change with the machine that runs it. Weeks start on Monday.

See also

emoji_trend() for the calendar-time view.

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  when = as.Date(c("2024-01-05", "2024-01-20", "2024-07-03")),
  text = c("\U0001f600", "\U0001f600\U0001f602", "plain")
)
emoji_seasonality(df, text, when)
#> # A tibble: 12 × 7
#>    .period .period_label n_texts n_with_emoji n_emoji emoji_per_text share
#>      <int> <chr>           <int>        <int>   <int>          <dbl> <dbl>
#>  1       1 Jan                 2            2       3            1.5     1
#>  2       2 Feb                 0            0       0           NA       0
#>  3       3 Mar                 0            0       0           NA       0
#>  4       4 Apr                 0            0       0           NA       0
#>  5       5 May                 0            0       0           NA       0
#>  6       6 Jun                 0            0       0           NA       0
#>  7       7 Jul                 1            0       0            0       0
#>  8       8 Aug                 0            0       0           NA       0
#>  9       9 Sep                 0            0       0           NA       0
#> 10      10 Oct                 0            0       0           NA       0
#> 11      11 Nov                 0            0       0           NA       0
#> 12      12 Dec                 0            0       0           NA       0
